title: Project 2 — LLM Routing Benchmark Public-Safe Manifest
license_note: Governed by LMSYS Chatbot Arena Conversations Terms of Use for academic research. This public manifest provides prompt identifiers, category labels, word counts, and router feature scores without raw text for lightweight integration against the upstream lmsys/chatbot_arena_conversations dataset. Full benchmark prompts and candidate outputs are provided in data/prompts.json and data/responses/ for research evaluation and complete reproducibility under LMSYS research terms.
